concepts.label: A 经典教材排版
concepts.heading: A  EDITORIAL
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: PREVIEW-ONLY brand concept presentation board for a four-volume offline English-learning iOS app serving Chinese, Japanese and Korean readers. Create ONE polished landscape board, roughly 1800x1000. Neutral white presentation background, no phone frame, no webpage or dashboard, no marketing hero, no gradients or bokeh on the board. Clear generous spacing. At left show ONE substantial square iOS icon preview with a rounded system mask. To its right show FOUR complete flat front-facing portrait book-cover designs in one evenly spaced row, each exactly 5:7 ratio. Same size, aligned top and bottom, no perspective, no cropped edges, no stacked books. The icon and covers must be visually coordinated but must not mimic any real publisher logo or existing textbook cover. On every cover, exact title in refined moderate-size typography: 'New Concept English'. Each cover has its own exact small label 'BOOK 1', 'BOOK 2', 'BOOK 3', 'BOOK 4' in order. Use clearly readable Arabic numbers 1, 2, 3, 4 but do NOT make a huge chunky numeral the central illustration. No Chinese, Japanese, Korean, flags, author names, publishers, ratings, CEFR or test-score claims, other copy, or watermarks. The only board heading is specified below. Adult educational app, thoughtful hierarchy, NOT a children's toy, NOT glossy 3D or inflated clay objects, NO giant ALL-CAPS condensed title covering a third of the cover. This is a useful design comparison showing the five actual proposed graphics, not a moodboard with unrelated swatches. Board heading exact text 'A  EDITORIAL'. Style: refined contemporary print-publishing design, mostly white covers, elegant editorial serif typography, crisp thin rules, generous negative space, restrained flat graphic details. Four distinct solid accent colors only in a narrow vertical spine strip and a small lower graphic: brick red, emerald green, cobalt blue, golden yellow. The title at the upper third is set on three graceful lines in black serif; book number is a calm small square corner label, not a giant object. Lower-half artwork: a sophisticated minimal open-page line composition, subtly different for each volume, mostly black with one accent. Icon: a bold simple white open-page/book symbol with a single contrasting bookmark on rich brick-red background, flat and crisp with no letters, no headphones, no shading. Overall very clean real-library educational book series, dignified, mature and easy to identify at small size. Render sufficiently large to inspect typography and complete covers.
